about_the_game:
Step into the ultimate hi-tech combo machine where every board holds hidden patterns waiting to be discovered. COMBOTRONICA is a futuristic roguelike deck-builder that transforms tile-linking into an art form, based on the original concept of chain building with deceptively simple rules that create enormous variety. Get ready for that perfect "just one more run" feeling that'll keep you chasing combos until dawn.

Build chains. Trigger combos. Watch the show.

Once you've crafted your chain, hit Submit and experience The Show - a spectacular scoring sequence that brings your strategy to life. Here's where the magic happens: each tile in your chain yields Points, but to reach those astronomical scores, you need Combos for the Multipliers! Combos trigger when multiple tiles combine by color or rank, and if you manage to link every tile on the board, you'll unlock the legendary Full Board Combo.

As level goals escalate into the stratosphere, you'll need more than clever chain-building to survive. Enter Amulets - your collection of game-changing companions that transform how you play.

These aren't just simple score boosters. Amulets provide lucrative Points and Multipliers to amplify your scoring, plus valuable Coins and Energy to fuel your strategic choices, all while bending the very rules of the game. Some offer straightforward power boosts perfect for beginners, while rare Amulets unlock sophisticated strategies that'll have you rethinking everything you know about chain-building.

After conquering each level, the Shop awaits with Amulets alongside other essential tools like Tokens, Scripts, and Chips. Tokens are tactical one-shots that manipulate the board or supercharge combos. Scripts & Chips offer different paths: Chips permanently unlock new abilities, while Scripts deliver powerful one-time effects.

Every stage culminates in a Boss battle - a devious challenge that throws a wrench in your well-laid plans. "Red tiles disabled!" "No linking from the bottom row!" These tricky modifiers force you to adapt on the fly, turning comfortable strategies upside down. With 40+ unique bosses to overcome, you'll need to master every tool at your disposal.

  • 100+ unique Amulets with game-changing effects

  • 80+ Scripts & Chips for strategic evolution and powerful one-time boosts

  • 70+ Tokens for tactical board manipulation

  • 23 different Tile types to discover and master

  • 10 distinct board manipulation techniques

  • 40+ Boss battles with unique challenge modifiers

  • 4 Game Paths including the advanced 4x3 board Ultra Path

  • 4 Competitive Leagues - climb from Starter through Core and Master to reach Champion League's world leaderboard

The deeper you go, the more COMBOTRONICA reveals its true nature: a game of endless variety where no two runs play the same, and there's always a new combo waiting to be discovered.
